auditor: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API), one call per section, reasoning_effort low
scope: compiled facts vs the handbook pages they cite (card backs are byte copies of these facts); exam items and lesson narration not checked in this pass

flagged.issue: Page 7 states the E and F moped/three-wheel rule but does not mention Class D holders for comparison.
flagged.suggested_fix: Class E and Class F holders may also operate a moped or three-wheel vehicle, but not a two-wheel motorcycle with a detachable sidecar.

flagged.issue: Page 12 states the passenger limit only for a conditional license, not for a special restricted license.
flagged.suggested_fix: A conditional licensee may carry at most two passengers under 21 unless a licensed adult aged 21 or older rides along, except for family or students to and from school.

flagged.issue: Page 6 states weight rating determines class but does not state that vehicle appearance does not decide.
flagged.suggested_fix: Class D is limited to non-commercial passenger vehicles of no more than 26,000 pounds GVW, and the GVWR/GVW determines which class you need.

flagged.issue: Page 10 requires written permission from any person in items 1-6, not only a parent, guardian or custodian.
flagged.suggested_fix: The list ends with a responsible adult who assumes duties under SC Code §56-1-110 and has notarized written permission from a person listed in items 1-6.

flagged.issue: Page 31 alone does not state the daytime limitation; the daytime condition appears on the prior page.
flagged.suggested_fix: On page 30 the manual limits golf-cart operation to daytime, with the page 31 details about the gate, distance and road types under SC Code §56-2-105.

flagged.issue: Page 31 alone does not state the daytime limitation; the daytime condition appears on the prior page.
flagged.suggested_fix: On page 30 the manual limits golf-cart operation to daytime, with the four-miles-from-gate detail continuing on page 31.

flagged.issue: The page does not state that out-of-state Form 412-NC is filed on paper.
flagged.suggested_fix: An SC-licensed professional files electronically while an out-of-state professional completes Form 412-NC.

flagged.issue: Page 56 does not state that push/pull is the preferred method; that statement is on page 55.
flagged.suggested_fix: 2 and 10 o'clock is not recommended because it can be dangerous in vehicles equipped with airbags.

flagged.issue: Page 56 states the low-speed use for hand-over-hand but does not state push/pull is preferred.
flagged.suggested_fix: Use hand-over-hand steering when turning the wheel at low speeds, such as at an intersection or when parking the vehicle.

flagged.issue: The page states the ideal-conditions maximum but does not state it is not a guarantee of safety.
flagged.suggested_fix: Speed limit signs indicate the maximum legal speed allowed in ideal conditions.

flagged.issue: The page states guide signs give information but does not on this page contrast them with laws to obey.
flagged.suggested_fix: Guide signs are green, brown or blue and give information and direction.

flagged.issue: Cited page 77 ends mid-sentence at 'turn hard left to' and does not state stopping when reaching the other side, which is on page 78.
flagged.suggested_fix: Limit the statement to what page 77 states, or cite pages 77-78 for the full step including stopping on the other side.

flagged.issue: Cited page 83 alone lists 'On any two-lane highway' but the explicit 'whether you are meeting the bus or traveling behind it' condition is stated on page 82, not page 83.
flagged.suggested_fix: Cite pages 82-83 for both directions, or limit to page 83 wording: stop is required on any two-lane highway.

flagged.issue: Page 124 alone does not state the orange and red triangle identifier, which appears on page 123.
flagged.suggested_fix: A slow-moving vehicle travels at less than 25 mph; use caution when approaching and be sure it is safe before you pass.

flagged.issue: Page 120 states the pull-over rule but does not state the comparison to the stopped-vehicle lane-change rule.
flagged.suggested_fix: For a moving emergency vehicle with lights and siren on, yield by pulling over to the edge of the road.

flagged.issue: The cited page ends at 'Stop as soon as you can safely' and does not state getting completely off the roadway, which is on the next page.
flagged.suggested_fix: If the trailer begins to sway or whip, steer straight and reduce speed gradually; do not apply the brakes, never increase speed, and stop as soon as you can safely do so.
